task.description:
Closing gate on WF03-ISS0213-20260821. DOC-UPDATER added a new cross-cutting section 'No Background Wait For A Cross-Turn Notification' to `core-directives.md`, plus a pointer in `.claude/agents/elixir-dev.md`. Commit `155ae7c` on `main` (this was a small docs run, no feature branch). Read the producer's own report in `handoffs/WF03-ISS0213-20260821/step-03-no-background-wait.json` `result`, then re-derive -- don't trust the summary.

RE-DERIVE, each item names what to check yourself:

1. READ THE NEW SECTION IN core-directives.md IN FULL. Confirm it states plainly: a dispatched agent completes its work within its own tool-call loop; long-running operations are run SYNCHRONOUSLY, waited on to completion in the same turn, with the real result read before the turn ends; an agent never ends its turn backgrounding an operation while expecting a future cross-turn notification -- that mechanism belongs to the top-level orchestrating session only.

2. VERIFY THE INCIDENT CITATION. Open `handoffs/WF03-ISS0193-20260821/step-final-git-merge.json` (specifically its `not_agent_attested`/`result` fields recording the stalled agent's own words) and confirm the new section's citation matches what actually happened -- the agent's own 'waiting for a background test monitor' phrasing, the orphaned-process side effect, and that ORCH resolved it via HANDOFF_PROTOCOL section 4.1(a-2).

3. CONFIRM HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md SECTION 4.1 IS GENUINELY UNTOUCHED. `git show 155ae7c -- docs/agents/shared/HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md` should show NOTHING -- that file must not appear in this commit at all. This is the load-bearing scope boundary: the issue is explicit that this is a prevention fix, not a recovery-procedure change, and section 4.1 already correctly handles the recovery shape.

4. JUDGE THE CANONICAL-HOME DECISION. Read `.claude/agents/elixir-dev.md`'s addition: confirm it is a genuine pointer (references core-directives.md's new section, does not restate the rule) placed sensibly (the report says it landed in the 'Self-review before finishing' list next to the mix test/mix compile checks). Judge whether core-directives.md is in fact the right canonical home given the hazard is about how ANY dispatched subagent behaves, not specific to ELIXIR-DEV -- or state if you would have chosen differently and why that does not rise to a FAIL.

5. CONFIRM THE EXISTING-STATEMENT SEARCH WAS REAL. The report claims a search across core-directives.md's own sections, ORCHESTRATOR.md, WF-02's workflow doc, test-runner.md, orchestrator.md and elixir-dev.md found no existing partial statement of this rule. Spot-check at least two of those files yourself for background/notification/async/polling language before accepting that this is fresh text rather than an undetected duplicate.

6. ISSUE CLOSURE. `docs/issues/ISS-0213.yaml` carries `status: resolved`, `resolved_in_run`, a plausible `resolved_at`. Confirm GH#421 is closed with `gh issue view 421 --json state,closedAt` directly.

7. BOOKKEEPING AND SCOPE. `git show --stat 155ae7c`: only `.claude/agents/elixir-dev.md`, `docs/agents/instructions/core-directives.md`, `docs/issues/ISS-0213.yaml` and this run's own handoff should appear. `handoffs/orchestrator.log`/`handoffs/registry.json` are ORCH's, deliberately uncommitted -- confirm 0 deletions on both and leave them alone. Confirm the step-03 handoff's own schema is clean: top-level `status` is `COMPLETED` (ORCH corrected a stale `IN_PROGRESS` mechanically after the report landed -- confirm the correction, not the original).

SCOPE OF `result.issues`: only genuine defects -- fails a criterion, contradicts another document, states a false checkable claim, or would mislead a later agent. Not style or wording preference.

VERDICT: PASS or FAIL against the seven acceptance criteria on the Step 03 handoff plus the items above. A FAIL names each failed criterion and the specific gap. Commit your own handoff file to `main` directly (docs-only, no feature branch). Do not write `registry.json` or `orchestrator.log`.
acceptance_criteria: The new core-directives.md section is read in full and confirmed to state completion-within-loop, synchronous waiting, and the no-cross-turn-notification rule unambiguously
The incident citation is verified against handoffs/WF03-ISS0193-20260821/step-final-git-merge.json's actual recorded account, not accepted from the summary
git show 155ae7c -- docs/agents/shared/HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md shows nothing -- section 4.1 is confirmed genuinely untouched
The elixir-dev.md addition is confirmed a genuine pointer, and the canonical-home choice is judged (agreed or a stated disagreement that does not rise to a FAIL)
At least two of the claimed-searched files were independently spot-checked for a pre-existing partial statement of this rule
GH#421's closed state was confirmed with gh directly, and ISS-0213.yaml's resolved fields were read from the file

git show --stat confirms scope is limited to the three docs files plus this run's own handoff; orchestrator.log/registry.json show 0 deletions; the step-03 handoff's top-level status is confirmed COMPLETED
result.issues contains only genuine defects, not stylistic observations
